title: Solving the Problem Using a Linear Approach

blocks.content: Solving the Problem Using a Linear Approach
In a linear approach, each element must have a unique predecessor and successor. However, our problem presents a branching path at city B.
To maintain linearity, we will choose the nearest immediate landmark, city C, as the successor of city B.
Using this logic, our route taken is: A -> B -> C -> D -> E -> F.
The total distance covered is: (2 + 4 + 4 + 1 + 2) = 13 km.
